components.name: Slug Mortar
components.blurb: Manifest: one slug, forty kilos, delivery by air. Eats a rack of ammunition per breakfast. Grundl reload it between bites.
components.quirk: Huge kinetic hits (6.5, piercing a cell; +44% over a tier-3 laser), but each shot spends three scrap. Grundl restock twice as fast.

components.name: Grapple Harpoon
components.blurb: A barbed head and forty metres of chain, for towing barges and, lately, enemy ships. Needs a Grundl on the winch or it takes all day.
components.quirk: Magnetic: pulls the enemy ship toward you. Reloads at only 30% rate unless a Grundl mans it.

components.name: Barge Flak
components.blurb: Four fat banded barrels over an ammo drum. Fires everything it has at everything that moves, then asks for more.
components.quirk: A big turret flak (six heavy pellets), but it spends two scrap a volley. Grundl restock twice as fast.
